Global Market Entry for Web3 Companies

WHAT WE DO

We get Web3 companies into new markets.
That means knowing which jurisdictions are actually open right now, which regulators and
infrastructure providers matter, what the compliance exposure looks like, and who the right
people are to talk to. Then making those introductions and helping you land.
Most Web3 companies trying to expand globally waste months figuring out basics that should
take days. They get stuck on licensing questions, make the wrong jurisdictional calls, or fail to
establish the relationships that determine whether a market works. We exist to remove that
friction.

SERVICES

Jurisdiction Intelligence
A structured briefing on a target market: regulatory status, licensing requirements and timelines,
tax exposure, enforcement posture, and the political economy of crypto in that jurisdiction.
Delivered as a working document your legal and strategy teams can actually use, not a generic
overview.
Covers all active Web3 markets: US, EU, UK, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong, and emerging
jurisdictions on request.
